To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) participatory risk management can be a powerful tool for managing community risk, (ii) PRM games can be a good way to incentivize community risk management, (iii) the PRM gaming system can be a good tool for incentivizing community members and netizen to participate in community risk management, and (iv) the PRM game system can be a powerful way to improve community safety and community members' safety awareness.
PRM games have the potential to improve the quality of risk management and the quality of life in a community.
PRM can be achieved through the design of gaming systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and testing the concept of PRM and the gaming system concept.
how to design games to incentivize community risk management and how to use games to manage community risks.
the development of a PRM gaming system that will enable community members to play games that will improve their ability to manage risk in the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
participatory risk management is a new approach to managing community risk that can be implemented through games.
the proposed PRM concept is a viable solution to community risk management and that the PRM game system is a good example application for PRM.
PRM is a promising approach to managing risks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the community can become safer and participants can become smarter in dealing risks through PRM.
the PRM gaming system can be used as a platform to engage the community in risk management.
we have designed, developed, and deployed a participatory risk management game for the city of Taipei.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the community can be a source of intelligence for risk management.
we believe that PRM is a viable approach to managing risks in a community.
PRM is a promising approach to improving community safety and that the concept can be extended to many other domains.
